annotations.text: Option A (recommended): doors framed by OUTCOME. Your note folded in: experienced rowers who want a recommendation fit through door 1, since the questionnaire asks about experience anyway.

The advice path: two questions, then the recommendation. Question wording is draft; the split numbers are PLACEHOLDERS. The real estimate model comes from the spec's research pass (Concept2 logbook rankings). Whether age/sex join the questions is an open call: better estimates, but health-adjacent data and App Privacy weight.
Door 2 reuses the You editor's fields, brought forward. Writes provenance manual.

Door 3 (James, settled): relaxed 6k OR raced 2k, rower's choice. The shipped BaselineCard already carries this exact toggle, so the build reuses it. Option A chosen for the doors; Option B kept below as the record of the road not taken.
Option B: identity framing. NOT CHOSEN (James, 2026-08-22). Kept for the record.

James's v0.19.0 feedback (2026-08-23): entering 1:58 from the 2:25 seed took 27 taps per field, with accidental text selection. Three directions, all with the app's top-left BACK restored (the designer call: bottom Back broke the house convention; top-left is where every other screen puts it). Recommendation: T as the primary control (the builder's shipped ClockInput pattern, two seconds per field, zero new mechanism), with S's coarse taps as the adjust affordance where a stepper already exists (the recommendation screen's adjust step). W is the most native-feeling and the most expensive to own on web; keep it in the pocket for a native-polish pass.
